products.name: Inferock Bench
products.tagline: An independent receipt for every LLM API call
products.description: Inferock-bench is a local proxy that sits between your app and OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter shaped calls. It captures per-call token usage, failures, and retries, then generates an independent receipt showing what you were billed and how much you're actually overpaying for.

products.name: GLM-5.3
products.tagline: Coding leap from scaled post-training on the same base
products.description: GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest model built for complex, long-horizon coding tasks. Through massive post-training scaling, it achieves open-source SOTA in agentic coding and demonstrates emergent capabilities in vulnerability discovery and cyber defense.

products.name: Big Mike
products.tagline: Your favorite uncle who knows sports & bets, on iMessage
products.description: Big Mike reads MLB, NFL/CFB, and NBA/WNBA all day and texts you the play in iMessage: what to bet, at what number, and which book has it. July Record: 115-68, +21.4 units. Every pick graded in public, no deleted losers. Star ruled out? Trade drops? He texts you what it does to the line. Add him to the group chat and the whole crew hears it at once. Fair warning: he stirs up banter. Link your Sleeper or ESPN league and the start/sit calls are about your roster. Ask Big Mike.

products.name: Zetik
products.tagline: A chief of staff in your pocket
products.description: Presidents and CEOs get strategy teams. You get… doomscrolling? Meet Zetik: an AI agent team running a full intelligence cycle — collect, filter, analyze, brief — across podcasts, papers, code, tweets & news, 24/7. It tracks whatever matters to you, in near real time.

products.name: Attyn
products.description: Attyn brings intelligence to the cursor inside the apps you already use. Rewrite selected text with Inline Assist, speak finished words with Realtime Dictation, ask about what is on screen with Screen Assist, and turn questions into visual explanations with Blackboard. Use Attyn Credits, bring a provider key, or run a supported local model. Attyn is bootstrapped and independent. Available for macOS today, with Windows on the way. Every new account starts with 500 launch credits.

products.name: nenspace
products.tagline: the lo-fi of LLMs: your mind, made larger
products.description: nenspace. an extended mind, not a second brain: your own, made larger. the lo-fi of LLMs fused with the one space that catches your thoughts and cultivates them: working memory, tasks, notes, habits, logbook. AI-fused, but not forced. your head holds about four things. nenspace holds the rest. free to start · web + ios

products.name: Joy
products.tagline: A Mac menu bar app that throws confetti for your wins
products.description: Joy is a macOS menu bar app that throws confetti the moment you hit a milestone - GitHub stars, Stripe sales, Docker Hub pulls, and more. Celebrate every win automatically.

products.name: FileRouter
products.tagline: Take control of files and editors
products.description: A default handler for multiple file types that opens the right editor — Velja/Choosy for files. Full control of any file type and what editor(s) open it, with radial picker and custom rules.

products.name: Chronock
products.tagline: Scheduling and calendar sync, all in one
products.description: Chronock combines scheduling and cross-calendar sync in one workspace. It checks availability across connected Google and Outlook calendars, turns open time into a booking page, and syncs events between work, personal, and project calendars to prevent double bookings. Guests see only bookable times, while you can review every connected event in one Integrated Calendar. Start free with no credit card.

products.name: Talvo
products.tagline: Connect 2,500+ European banks to track your spending
products.description: The European money tracker & budgeting app. Connect 2,500+ banks via PSD2, auto-categorise every transaction, track budgets & net worth. EU-hosted, GDPR native.

products.name: Clamshell
products.tagline: Close your MacBook. Keep the work running.
products.description: Closing my MacBook used to kill whatever I had left running: a build, a download, sometimes an agent halfway through a task. I made Clamshell to fix that. The lid shuts, the screen goes dark, and the work carries on. No monitor, sudo, or admin setup.
